label: Flutter: escolher device/emulador e rodar
command: R="$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"; [ -f "$R/pubspec.yaml" ] || R="$R/vanep-mobile"; cd "$R" || exit 1; bash "$R/.zed/flutter-device.sh" run

label: Flutter: ligar emulador (escolher)
command: R="$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"; [ -f "$R/pubspec.yaml" ] || R="$R/vanep-mobile"; cd "$R" || exit 1; bash "$R/.zed/flutter-device.sh" emulator

label: Flutter: rodar (device padrão do flutter)
command: R="$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"; [ -f "$R/pubspec.yaml" ] || R="$R/vanep-mobile"; cd "$R" || exit 1; if [ -f .fvmrc ] && command -v fvm >/dev/null; then fvm flutter run; else flutter run; fi

label: Flutter: listar devices e emuladores
command: R="$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"; [ -f "$R/pubspec.yaml" ] || R="$R/vanep-mobile"; cd "$R" || exit 1; f() { if [ -f .fvmrc ] && command -v fvm >/dev/null; then fvm flutter "$@"; else flutter "$@"; fi; }; f devices; f emulators

label: Flutter: build_runner
command: R="$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"; [ -f "$R/pubspec.yaml" ] || R="$R/vanep-mobile"; cd "$R" || exit 1; if [ -f .fvmrc ] && command -v fvm >/dev/null; then fvm dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs; else dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs; fi
